title: Absolutely indecomposable quasi-parabolic $G$-bundles and the multiplicity of irreducible characters
summary: Absolutely indecomposable vector bundle and parabolic vector bundles are well-studied via quiver representations. In this paper, we study absolutely indecomposable quasi-parabolic $G$-bundles over $\mathbb{P}^1$ with generic additive character varieties. Furthermore, we give a geometric interpretation of the multiplicity of the tensor product of irreducible characters of finite reductive groups using generic additive character varieties.
